facts.text: Audrey expressed that spreading peaceful feelings to others is a great way to bring happiness and motivation.

evidence.quote: That's really cool! Spreading that peaceful feeling to others is such a great way to bring happiness and motivation.

facts.text: Andrew agreed that spreading peaceful feelings brings joy and motivates people to find their own peace, describing it as a ripple effect that spreads positivity.

evidence.quote: I agree! It brings me joy to spread that feeling and motivate people to find their own peace - it's like a ripple effect, spreading positivity.

facts.text: Audrey stated that both the person spreading and receiving the peaceful feeling experience positive effects.

evidence.quote: Absolutely. Not only the receiving end feels great, the person spreading it will feel great as well!

facts.text: Andrew noted that spreading good vibes and joy is the goal, and even the littlest gestures can have a big effect on people.

evidence.quote: We don't realize it, but even the littlest gestures can have a big effect. Spreading good vibes and joy, that's the goal right?
